== Pre-auction ==
The [[Board of Control for Cricket in India]] set the deadline of 26 November 2023 5 pm IST for IPL teams to announce their lists of players to be retained and released before the auction.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/ipl-teams-retained-players-release-deadline-november-26-auction-december-19-bcci/article67494214.ece|title=IPL 2024: BCCI extends player retention deadline to November 26|work=Sportstar|date=3 November 2023 |access-date=30 November 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=IPL 2024 auction: Titans' Hardik-sized hole, and other key positions the teams need to fill |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2024-auction-holes-mi-csk-kkr-rcb-srh-dc-gt-lsg-pbks-rr-need-to-fill-1412875 |access-date=2023-12-18 |work=ESPNcricinfo |language=en}}</ref>

== Auction ==
The IPL 2024 auction was conducted on 19 December 2023 in [[Dubai]]. A total of 333 players were available for auction including 214 Indian and 119 foreign players.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-news/ipl-auction-2024-december-19-time-teams-squads-remaining-purse-money-left-slots-full-players-list-base-price/article67640875.ece | title=IPL Auction 2024: Start date and time, full players list, updated squads, base price, purse left and slots available on December 19 | work=Sportstar The Hindu | date=19 December 2023}}</ref> 77 places were available to be filled across the ten teams including 30 overseas slots. [[Mitchell Starc]] became the most expensive player in IPL auction's history when he was bought at 24.75 crore by [[Kolkata Knight Riders]], surpassing [[Pat Cummins]] who was bought for 20.50 crore by [[Sunrisers Hyderabad]] in the same auction. [[Pat Cummins]] had surpassed [[Sam Curran]]'s record of 18.50 crore in [[List of 2023 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2023 auction]].<ref>[https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2024-auction-mitchell-starc-travis-head-rachin-ravindra-shardul-thakur-go-under-the-hammer-1413456  Starc shatters Cummins' record for most expensive player at IPL auction] ESPNcricinfo. 19 December 2023.</ref> On the other hand, prominent players like [[Steve Smith (cricketer)|Steve Smith]], [[Michael Bracewell (cricketer)|Michael Bracewell]], [[Josh Hazlewood]] and [[Josh Inglis]] went unsold.

[[Mallika Sagar]] was announced as the auctioneer for the hosting of the auction and she replaced Hugh Edmeades for the role as Edmeades stepped aside from hosting the auction due to health issues.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mallika Sagar: Who Is Women's Premier League 2024 Auctioneer? {{!}} Cricket News |url=https://sports.ndtv.com/women-s-premier-league-2024/mallika-sagar-who-is-womens-premier-league-2024-auctioneer-4648489 |access-date=2024-11-16 |website=NDTVSports.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-12-18 |title=All about Mallika Sagar: The first female auctioneer in the history of IPL |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/etimes/trending/all-about-mallika-sagar-the-first-female-auctioneer-in-the-history-of-ipl/articleshow/106098635.cms |access-date=2024-11-16 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> Mallika Sagar became the first female auctioneer in the Indian Premier League during the process.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-12-18 |title=IPL 2024 Auction: Mallika Sagar to replace Hugh Edmeades as auctioneer |url=https://www.firstpost.com/firstcricket/sports-news/ipl-2024-auction-mallika-sagar-hugh-edmeades-auctioneer-13516112.html |access-date=2024-11-16 |website=Firstpost |language=en-us}}</ref>
